summary.text: Al Green represents Texas's 9th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and began his eleventh term on January 3, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Born in New Orleans, he earned a law degree from the Thurgood Marshall School of Law in 1973 and co-founded a law firm.
He was elected Justice of the Peace in Harris County in 1977, serving 26 years until 2004, and was president of the Houston branch of the NAACP for about ten years.
